findings.message: The fixed candidate path and single select decision cannot represent distinct candidate sets for multiple declared artifacts with the same extension.
findings.paved_road: Define artifact-specific candidate paths and selection behavior, or explicitly change the graphics contract to allow exactly one generate-mode artifact.

findings.message: The existing Render grammar accepts multiple generate-mode artifacts, which the ticket’s single candidate path cannot distinguish.
findings.paved_road: If the intended design is one artifact, fence this file and update validation and its tests; otherwise retain the grammar and define artifact-specific candidate paths.

findings.message: The authoring guide explicitly permits one or more generated artifacts, so a one-artifact restriction would make this out-of-scope contract false.
findings.paved_road: If restricting generate mode to one artifact, fence and update the guide along with the grammar.
